I'll filter out the C shape, since it does not appear twice.

I'm now diving into this test input, to confirm rules about shape repetition. Analyzing the input, it seems I should keep the hollow rectangle appearing twice, and discard the shapes unique in the grid. Both the color 3 and 4 shapes seem to match: a 5x3 hollow rectangle, and thus will be kept! This reinforces my hypothesis.
